description: Generate, parse, modify, and format Microsoft Word (.docx) documents programmatically. Use when creating styled corporate reports, extracting text and tables from Word documents with python-docx, manipulating document sections, headers, footers, and page breaks, replacing placeholders without losing formatting, or inspecting OpenXML structures and untrusted Word files. Do not use for legacy binary .doc files, PDFs, Google Docs, or for tracked-changes editing workflows that need Word's revision model (python-docx does not write tracked changes).
